spanish: Y escribirá las maldiciones estas el sacerdote en el rollo, y borrará a aguas de las amargas.

findings.issue: מֵי is construct and הַמָּרִים is a masculine plural adjective agreeing with the waters (“the bitter waters”). “de las amargas” makes a feminine substantive, a separate genitive referent the adjective does not license.
אֶל marks the waters as the goal of מָחָה, and no token makes them the object wiped. “borrará a aguas” can be read as erasing the waters.

notes: Write, curses, these, priest, in the scroll, and the untranslated object marker match the tokens.
